ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms credential classes, a rotation interval and the ownerless flag are declared; it does not show any credential was rotated.
offer: Assign credential classes a rotation interval and an accountable owner. A reminder is a scheduling control and does not demonstrate that a credential was rotated.

minimal.reason: List the credential classes covered, such as API keys and deploy tokens. Unlisted classes never rotate, so name them.

mid.reason: Set a rotation interval in days, at least 90 declared. An unscheduled credential lives forever, so set the interval.

maximal.reason: Set rotation without an owner to false. A reminder nobody owns is ignored, so assign a responsible person or team.

rule.reason: List the credential classes covered, such as API keys and deploy tokens. Unlisted classes never rotate, so name them.
